definition: Read the Leidy trench at its upper endpoint, omit the less clean first peat hole, double the second cap to test net loss and move the Furnace auger to a corner of its mapped frame. Treat Patterson and Fish as lake ceilings, omit the assumed Lily bed and use the 26 cm Table 1 Dead Horse endpoint. Carp uses the 2 cm compiler alternative.
scope: Independent full-data source-interpretation refit. This is not an independent geographic validation or a replacement for the principal fixed-prior study.
